steps.name: Configure Maven toolchains
steps.run:
cat > "${{ runner.temp }}/toolchains.xml" <<EOF
<toolchains>
  <toolchain>
    <type>jdk</type>
    <provides><version>17</version></provides>
    <configuration><jdkHome>${{ steps.jdk17.outputs.path }}</jdkHome></configuration>
  </toolchain>
</toolchains>
EOF
echo "MAVEN_TOOLCHAIN_ARGS=-t ${{ runner.temp }}/toolchains.xml -Dtoolchain.jdk.discover=false" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Test
steps.run:
TEST_MODULES=$(./.github/workflows/stage.sh ${{ matrix.module }})
echo "github ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
echo "Start testing modules: $TEST_MODULES"
mvn -B verify $TEST_MODULES $MAVEN_TOOLCHAIN_ARGS -Ptest-coverage -P${{ startsWith(matrix.module, 'spark3') && 'test-spark3' || format('test-{0}', matrix.module) }} -Dlog.dir=${{ runner.temp }}/fluss-logs -Dlog4j.configurationFile=${{ github.workspace }}/tools/ci/log4j.properties ${{ inputs.maven-parameters }}

pipelines.name: Client Integration

steps.run:
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
  all=true; changed=""
else
  all=false
  changed=$(git diff --name-only "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}...HEAD")
fi
echo "Changed files:"; echo "$changed"
has() { echo "$changed" | grep -qE "$1"; }
# a change to this workflow itself should exercise every suite
has '^\.github/workflows/client-integration\.yml' && all=true || true
protocol=false; core=false; py=false; cpp=false; ex=false; gateway=false
has '^(fluss-rpc/src/main/proto/|fluss-server/|fluss-common/|fluss-dist/|LICENSE-bin$|NOTICE-bin$|docker/fluss/)' && protocol=true || true
has '^(fluss-rust/crates/|fluss-rust/Cargo\.)' && core=true || true
has '^fluss-rust/bindings/python/' && py=true || true
has '^fluss-rust/bindings/cpp/' && cpp=true || true
has '^fluss-rust/bindings/elixir/' && ex=true || true
has '^fluss-gateway/' && gateway=true || true
# a suite runs if: non-PR (all) OR core crate OR server/proto OR its own sources changed
gate() { if [ "$all" = true ] || [ "$core" = true ] || [ "$protocol" = true ] || [ "$1" = true ]; then echo true; else echo false; fi; }
# PRs run on arm64, whose queue stays short at peak hours. Pushes to main
# run on x86, so a merge that breaks only x86 still shows up there.
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then runner=ubuntu-24.04-arm; else runner=ubuntu-24.04; fi
{
  echo "runner=$runner"
  echo "rust=$(gate false)"
  echo "python=$(gate $py)"
  echo "cpp=$(gate $cpp)"
  echo "elixir=$(gate $ex)"
  echo "gateway=$(gate $gateway)"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Build server image (fluss:dev) from source
steps.run:
./mvnw -B --no-transfer-progress clean package -pl fluss-dist -am -DskipTests
cmp LICENSE-bin build-target/LICENSE
cmp NOTICE-bin build-target/NOTICE
rm -rf docker/fluss/build-target
mkdir -p docker/fluss/build-target
cp -r build-target/* docker/fluss/build-target/
docker build -t fluss:dev docker/fluss
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --entrypoint /bin/sh fluss:dev \
  -c 'test -s /opt/fluss/LICENSE && test -s /opt/fluss/NOTICE'
docker save fluss:dev -o /tmp/fluss-dev.tar

pipelines.name: Release Python

steps.name: Generate licenses for this wheel target
Check the sdist and every wheel
steps.run:
SDIST=$(ls artifacts/wheels-sdist/*.tar.gz)
PREFIX=$(basename "$SDIST" .tar.gz)
for f in LICENSE NOTICE LICENSE-bin NOTICE-bin; do
  if [ -z "$(tar -xzOf "$SDIST" "${PREFIX}/${f}" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "Error: ${f} is missing or empty at the root of ${SDIST}"
    exit 1
  fi
done
for whl in artifacts/wheels-*/dist/*.whl; do
  artifact_dir=$(dirname "$(dirname "$whl")")
  for f in LICENSE NOTICE LICENSE-bin NOTICE-bin; do
    if ! unzip -p "$whl" "*.dist-info/licenses/${f}" 2>/dev/null | grep . >/dev/null; then
      echo "Error: ${f} is missing or empty in ${whl}"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
  for f in LICENSE-bin NOTICE-bin; do
    if ! unzip -p "$whl" "*.dist-info/licenses/${f}" | diff -u "${artifact_dir}/${f}" -; then
      echo "Error: packaged ${f} differs from the generated file in ${whl}"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done

steps.name: Verify LICENSE, NOTICE and the dependency inventory in the crate
steps.run:
FILES=$(cargo package --list --allow-dirty -p fluss-rs)
for f in LICENSE NOTICE DEPENDENCIES.rust.tsv; do
  if ! echo "$FILES" | grep -qx "$f"; then
    echo "Error: ${f} is missing from the fluss-rs crate"
    exit 1
  fi
done
